auth.verificationBody: Upload your eGov certificate (large family, disability, single parent, etc.). Your document will be sent for review — this takes time. We'll email you the result.

auth.verificationOptional: (optional — you can upload it later via your profile)
auth.partnerReview: Your business registration will be sent for review by our team. Once approved, you'll receive a digital partnership agreement via email.
auth.partnerApplicationError: Could not submit the business application. Please try again.
auth.donorBankNote: You can register any Kaspi, Halyk, Forte, Jusan, or Freedom bank card after sign-up. 100% of your donation goes to the recipient's request.

donate.successBody: We've saved your pledge. Payment processing isn't live yet, so no charge has been made and the campaign total hasn't changed — our team will follow up once payments are enabled.
donate.signInNotice: You'll need to sign in to donate. Choose an amount below, then continue to sign in.
donate.monthlyDesc: Each month, this amount is auto-charged and distributed to the most urgent requests.
donate.insertError: Could not record your donation intent. Please try again.

landing.heroSub: The first charity platform in Kazakhstan where your donation turns into specific products, not untraceable cash. Real food and medicine for those in need, verified by AI.
landing.loopSub: From your wallet to their hands, every Tenge is tracked by our smart ecosystem.

step1.title: Donor Funds
step1.desc: Choose a specific campaign or person. Your funds are locked into the SENIM smart contract immediately.

step2.title: AI Verification
step2.desc: Recipients are verified via government databases and face-ID to ensure aid goes to real people in need.

step3.title: QR Voucher
step3.desc: The recipient receives a digital voucher on their phone, restricted to specific product categories only.

step4.title: Retail Redemption
step4.desc: Vouchers are scanned at Magnum, Small, or Europharma. Retailer gets paid instantly by SENIM.

landing.ctaTitle: Join the most transparent charity network in Central Asia.
landing.ctaSub: Every voucher is recorded on the blockchain, and every retail receipt is available for your audit. No management fees, just pure impact.

partners.title: Partner Stores
partners.subtitle: Trusted stores and pharmacies where SENIM vouchers can be redeemed.
partners.empty: No partner stores have been added yet.

browse.title: Urgent Assistance Requests
browse.subtitle: Direct aid for families and individuals across Kazakhstan. Every tenge goes directly to the partner store to fulfill these specific needs.
browse.transparentBody: Your contribution is paid directly to the merchant. SENIM takes 0% commission on individual requests.

createRequest.title: New Assistance Request
createRequest.subtitle: Describe your need — donors can support it directly.
createRequest.successBody: Your assistance request has been published. Donors can support it.
createRequest.notAuthorized: Sign in to create an assistance request.
createRequest.notVerified: You need to be verified to create an assistance request. Your application is under review — we'll reach out once approved.
createRequest.submitError: Could not submit the request. Please try again.

impact.title: Live Impact Dashboard
impact.subtitle: Real-time verification of every Tenge donated. SENIM ensures your contribution reaches those in need with 100% blockchain-backed transparency.
impact.mealsNote: Every ₸1,000 donated provides approx. 2 balanced meals for a family of four.
impact.auditBody: Access our full ledger, independent audit reports, and legal compliance documents. We operate on a 'Zero Shadow' policy.
impact.charityNote: SENIM is registered under the Charity Act of Kazakhstan. Every donation is tax-deductible for residents.
